Comment: Aadesh Standing Order machine. The state names and the Next chain here are asserted, state by state, against aadesh_core.standing_order.machine by tests/unit/test_asl_matches_core_machine.py, and the graph properties -- one durable wait, no timer, no route to the seal that skips the acknowledgement -- by tests/verification/test_workflow_contract.py. The Lambda ARNs are ${...FunctionArn} substitutions resolved by the SAM template, so the deployed machine calls THIS stack's functions rather than a name it guessed.

StageTrip.Comment: The invoked stage is read from the corpus. It is never computed from an AQI number.

Catch.Comment: A catcher carries only ErrorEquals, Next and ResultPath. A ResultSelector belongs on the state, not on the catcher, so it is not used here.

ResolveObligations.Comment: Which cited clauses apply, against a corpus that was just re-proved.

Authorize.Comment: The order was signed days ago. This asks whether it is still in force NOW.

CreateParchis.Comment: Idempotent on the execution id the API already used, so a retry cannot mint a second set.

PendingAck.Comment: One branch per displaced worker, each parked on its own task token. The machine holds PENDING_ACK here -- across a shift change, a night, a next-morning walk back to the site. No Lambda can hold that, and no timer may stand in for it.

BuildItem.Comment: The barrier between the machine's data and the waiter's: it narrows the iteration's item to exactly the three facts the waiter must know, and nothing else. NOTE on the paths -- with the classic Iterator form, EACH ITERATION'S INPUT IS THE ITEM, so `$.parchi_id` reads a field of the item and `$$.Map.Item.Value` is NOT available: a definition using `$$.Map.Item.Value.parchi_id` validates against the schema and then fails at runtime with 'JSONPath could not be found'. That was measured, not assumed.

AwaitWorkerAck.Comment: Parks this branch's task token. It resumes only on a SendTaskSuccess from the acknowledgement path -- never on a clock. TimeoutSeconds is the acknowledgement window (24 h, matching the token's own TTL); without it Step Functions would default to a year. HeartbeatSeconds is deliberately absent: a cb-only task has no heartbeat to send, and one would fail the wait on a worker who was simply still walking to the site, reporting 'no answer' about a question that was never withdrawn.

Catch.Comment: A worker who did not answer must not fail the whole execution.

AckTimeout.Comment: The branch's honest terminus. It says unacknowledged, so nothing downstream can read a missing confirmation as a confirmation.

Result.reason: worker did not acknowledge within the waiting window

WorkerAcknowledgements.Comment: The join. Every branch above has settled -- acknowledged or timed out -- before the machine reaches the seal, which is why no route can seal a Parchi nobody was asked about.

SealParchis.Comment: Freezes the Parchis the workers actually confirmed. The domain refuses to seal anything else, so a retry can never fabricate a sealed record.

Audit.Comment: One line that the run happened, and what it concluded. It runs on the failure path too, and it cannot fail open: a Catch here would let a lost audit line be a silent success.
